At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

What is the sum of Emil's dad's and brother's current ages? Emil is currently 19 years old. When Emil turns 24, he will be half as old as his dad. When Emil turns 24, he will be twice as old as his brother. Emil's dad is currently 43 years old.
